plugins.description: Automatically format Go files with gofmt after Write/Edit/MultiEdit operations

plugins.name: python-formatter-ruff
plugins.description: Automatically format Python files with Ruff after Write/Edit/MultiEdit operations

plugins.name: go-style-guide
plugins.description: Review Go code for adherence to Go Style Guide. Use when the user requests a code review of completed work, pull requests, or feature branches in Go projects.

plugins.description: Gemini CLI integration with focused skills for web search, plan review, code review, and architecture analysis
